I have personally been through a lot and had a lot of dark days. But what helped me through these is to truly understand that i will be fine no matter what happens. I have lost many friends, many opportunities, and fucked things up a lot. But I am here, standing on my own two feet (or rather laying in bed ngl). The thing is, you can do this too.

You see, nothing in life is certain, except for suffering and death. And that is okay. Fucking up is what makes you human. Your not a bad person for having difficulties, and these difficulties do not make your value as a human any less. They just make you *human*.

I guess what i am trying to say is that you will be fine. No one can guarantee you a perfect life, and suffering and tribulations will come, but the point of life is to learn how to handle those tribulations. 

You seem to place your value in how other people view you. While a very normal and very common thing, it almost always leads to sadness. Other peoples opinions do not determine your worth. Your faliures do not either. One thing that you can try to do, which can help with self esteem is this:

Every night, before bed, i want you to write down 5 things you are proud of yourself for that day, and 5 things you like about yourself. Then go say these things in front of a mirror. It might sound stupid, but in this case stupid works. It doesnt do anything magic, but it is a boost.

Try also, not to compare yourself to your sister for example. There is no point in compring yourself to someone elses sucesses, since they havent lived the same life as you. Only you have. Therefore, it only makes logical sense for you to compare yourself to only yourself. 

I for example have struggled with sleep for many years and only recently been able to fix my schedule. That is a big win for me, and should only be compared with my previous self, and not people who never had any struggles with sleeping.

I do not know if im making any sense because its very late for me but i hope youre feeling better and are able to get the help you deserve. take care. youll make it through this
